name: Zedekiah (son of Kenaanah, prophet under Ahab)
title: False prophet under King Ahab
summary: Zedekiah, son of Kenaanah, was one of the false prophets who served under King Ahab of Israel. He is best known for his confrontation with the true prophet Micaiah, son of Imlah, where he falsely prophesied victory in the battle at Ramoth Gilead. His false prophecy led to Ahab's defeat and death in the battle.

keyEvents.title: Makes iron horns as a sign
keyEvents.description: Zedekiah made iron horns for himself and prophesied that Ahab would gore the Arameans until they were destroyed, as a symbolic sign of victory.

keyEvents.title: Prophesies victory at Ramoth Gilead
keyEvents.description: Along with about 400 other prophets, Zedekiah prophesied that King Ahab would win the war against the Arameans at Ramoth Gilead and encouraged the king to go to battle.

keyEvents.title: Confrontation with the prophet Micaiah
keyEvents.description: When the true prophet Micaiah, son of Imlah, prophesied defeat for Ahab, Zedekiah struck him on the cheek and challenged him by asking how the Spirit of the Lord had gone from him to Micaiah.

keyEvents.title: Micaiah answers Zedekiah
keyEvents.description: The prophet Micaiah answered Zedekiah that he would see it on the day he had to flee from room to room to hide, which suggested that Zedekiah's false prophecy would be exposed.

keyEvents.title: Ahab's defeat and death confirm the false prophecy
keyEvents.description: Ahab went to war against Ramoth in Gilead based on the advice of the false prophets, including Zedekiah, but was mortally wounded in battle – confirming that Micaiah had spoken truth and Zedekiah had prophesied lies.
